dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me, are there any events happening as of late?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: There happens to be a salad tasting event ongoing now.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Here you go. If you like it, you can always visit me again.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Welcome to Good Hunter. How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Can I get food to-go?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Certainly. Here's the menu.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask about something.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh? What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Thank you for coming to Good Hunter. Do come back next time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is Good Hunter?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Good Hunter is the best restaurant in town. We are famous for our Venison Steak and Satisfying Salad.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The hunters in Springvale provide us with the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: All ingredients are brought in fresh every day.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I can tell you about any item on the menu if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Judging by your looks, you must be a traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Mondstadt truly is a great place for visitors.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Its temperate climate and clean water give birth to the best apples in all of Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Our famous Satisfying Salad has Mondstadt apples in it. Do you want to give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: *sigh* Business has really taken a turn for the worse ever since Stormterror appeared. Nobody's in the mood to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Even those customers who do show up do nothing but sigh and moan...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But I suppose that's normal. I just hope that all this will be over soon.
